summary: Design an AI and automation CoE charter, operating model, and portfolio toolkit. Explore practical training for prioritization, funding, risk, and value trackin
lede: AI and automation Centre of Excellence training helps digital and technology leaders coordinate use cases through a governed portfolio. It covers defining a CoE charter and service model, screening and prioritizing proposals, and setting funding and decision rights. Participants also build benefits-tracking tools and an executive portfolio update to monitor outcomes, ownership, and progress.
audienceIntro: This course suits leaders accountable for coordinating AI and automation work across teams, portfolios, governance functions, and executive reporting. It is designed for people who need to turn scattered proposals into a governed, prioritized CoE portfolio.
modules: NIST AI RMF Intake and Triage
prerequisites: Prior experience with digital transformation, technology delivery, AI initiatives, automation, or project portfolio decisions is recommended. No coding or programming is required.
